graph_semantics.node_identity: Named product and version; missing versions remain explicit nulls and unresolved_version status. Source-family nodes are used where a public record does not identify a narrower product.
graph_semantics.verification: verified_dependency means the product/algorithm-family dependency is documented. Missing acquisition evidence, unknown input versions, exact file identities, regional selection and historical build carry-forward are retained as metadata and do not invalidate that relationship. A false dependency flag denotes a substantive relationship uncertainty; comparison edges are never ingestion dependencies.
graph_semantics.historical_and_unresolved: Included in graph with applicability and verification attributes; not suppressed for lack of acquisition verification.
graph_semantics.self_loops: Temporal dependency records preserve prior-acquisition or internal-state annotations in evidence and GraphML temporal_dependencies metadata; no self-loop edges are drawn.
graph_semantics.boundary: Each node records expanded lineage and/or documentary boundary. Boundary means the consulted public documentation cannot resolve a further input identity at that branch, not proof of no additional inputs. Access gaps are identified separately.
graph_semantics.shared_ancestry: Read common-ancestor paths; no arbitrary directed pairwise shared-ancestry edges are added. No independence inferred from a missing path.
graph_semantics.validation: Validation edges are comparisons, never verified ingestion dependencies.
graph_semantics.display_guidance: All edges use the same gray color and width. Solid lines include grouped, calibration and acquisition-supported relationships. Dashed lines and question marks denote only genuinely uncertain dependencies. No acquisition highlights or calibration captions; unknown version details remain metadata. Self-loops are omitted from all graph views and retained as temporal dependency records in evidence/GraphML metadata. Selected inputs use neutral fills; green denotes shared sources. Input-status annotations and explanatory sidebar prose are omitted; scientific qualifications remain metadata.

semantics.groups: A bundle contains distinct products; connections retain exact member endpoints. Membership alone never asserts a dependency.
semantics.summary_edges: Boundary relationships plus explicit internal path witnesses; no new scientific direct-ingestion claim.
semantics.uncertainty: Conjunction of product-level dependency verification across supporting dependency edges; acquisition coverage and unresolved version details are separate metadata, never reasons for a question mark.
semantics.scope: Documented product dependencies retained regardless of acquisition verification; validation comparisons remain in evidence and are omitted from the default overview.
semantics.selected_inputs: Blue nodes identify selected study inputs: soil-moisture products or indirect observations. Blue does not establish that a retrieval is complete or an input has been ingested.
semantics.version_display: Keep known versions in labels and unresolved version details in properties/evidence; no [v?] markers.
semantics.edge_display: All edges use the same gray color and width. Solid lines include grouped, calibration and acquisition-supported relationships. Dashed lines and question marks denote only genuinely uncertain dependencies. No acquisition highlights or calibration captions; unknown version details remain metadata. Self-loops are omitted from all graph views and retained as temporal dependency records in evidence/GraphML metadata.
